S4.explanation: Protocol specifies 2 factors x 2 dynamics x 6 horizons/variants = 24. Script implements 2 factors x 2 dynamics x 4 horizons = 16. The 6th horizon/variant dimension was not implemented.

S5.explanation: Protocol specifies 2 arch x 2 context x 6 horizon/seed variants = 24. Script implements 2 arch x 2 context x 4 horizons x 3 variants = 48. The 3 signal variants (full, half-amplitude, sign-only) were added beyond the planned 6 variants.

section_1_candidate_universe.registry_diff_summary: S4 missing 8 candidates (4 horizons instead of 6). S5 has 24 extra candidates (3 variants x 4 horizons x 2 arch x 2 ctx = 48 instead of 6 variants x 2 arch x 2 ctx = 24). Net: -8 + 24 = +16. 144 + 16 = 160.
section_1_candidate_universe.explanation: The 160-candidate execution registry was defined in the uncommitted run script (D:\ComputaCenter\v3_processing\run_v5_discovery.py), written AFTER the prospective seal. The seal only fixed the 144-candidate protocol. The actual 160-candidate universe was NOT immutably fixed before any outcome existed.

section_2_timing.prospective_seal_content: V5 prospective protocol (144 candidates) + V4 terminal closure
section_2_timing.finding: POST_OUTCOME_PROTOCOL_DEVIATION: The executed 160-candidate universe was defined in uncommitted code after the seal. The seal fixed 144 candidates; the runtime expanded to 160 without a new seal.

section_3_reproducibility.finding: POST_OUTCOME_REPRODUCIBILITY_DEFECT: All code that generated signals, candidates, execution, P&L, and statistics resides in an uncommitted file outside the repository. No SHA exists for the execution code. The run cannot be independently reproduced from the repository.

section_4_date_roles.explanation: The M1-level mask (ny_date >= EVAL_START & ny_date <= EVAL_END & exec_ & obs) was computed but DISCARDED. The aggregated mask (mask_a = exec_a & ~np.isnan(mid_a)) contains NO date filter and NO obs flag. 97.7% of aggregated bars pass the mask (vs 50% expected if date-filtered). n_days=2503/instrument is impossible for 4 years (max 1460) but consistent with 8 years (2009-2017). CONCLUSION: 2010-2013 data IS in the evaluated P&L.

S2_regime.detail: vol_med = np.nanmedian(rv[mask]) computes the median realized vol over the FULL unfiltered evaluation period (2009-2017) and uses it as a static threshold for all bars. This is a full-sample statistic applied retroactively. Bars in 2010 are gated by a threshold that includes 2016-2017 data.

S4_factor.detail: Uses rolling 24-bar window (ret[i-24:i]) for factor estimation. Causal. No future data used.

S5_sequence.detail: Uses rolling context window (ret[i-ctx:i], rng[i-ctx:i], spf[i-ctx:i]) with exponential decay weights. Causal. No future data used.

S1_kalman.detail: Recursive filter processes bars sequentially. Causal by construction.

section_6_panel_accounting.explanation: 160 candidates x 13 instruments = 2080 instrument-level results. Each candidate is evaluated independently per instrument, then results are SUMMED across instruments to produce one aggregate row per candidate.
section_6_panel_accounting.wrc_spa_input: WRC/SPA were NEVER COMPUTED. The statistics file contains placeholder values (wrc_p=1.0, spa_p=1.0). No daily P&L matrix was constructed for cross-candidate comparison.
section_6_panel_accounting.pseudo_independence: The 13 instrument-level results for a given candidate are NOT statistically independent (shared macro factors, correlated spreads). However, since WRC/SPA were never computed, this did not affect any reported statistic.
section_6_panel_accounting.verdict: PANEL_ACCOUNTING_ADEQUATE (no statistics were computed that could be affected)

section_7_economic_reconciliation.verification: VERIFIED for representative candidates from all 5 active families (S1-S5). S7 has 0 trades.
section_7_economic_reconciliation.clarification: The large negative values (-300k to -450k bps) are CUMULATIVE SUMS of per-trade P&L across ~97,000 trades, NOT portfolio returns. Per-trade net is -3.7 to -4.5 bps, dominated by spread cost (~1.9 bps/trade) + commission (0.4 bps/trade) exceeding gross edge.

S7.classification: ZERO_TRADES (cost filter too strict, all signals blocked)

section_8_turnover_audit.material_deviations: S7 produced ZERO trades for all 24 candidates. The cost-aware stopping rule (|expected_move| > spread + cost) was too restrictive, blocking all entries. This is a design failure, not a protocol violation.
section_8_turnover_audit.verdict: TURNOVER_WITHIN_PROTOCOL (all active families at 3.0 cap; S7 degenerate)

daily_pnl_matrix.note: No daily P&L matrix was built. daily_pnl_vec() was called per-candidate but results were only used for Sharpe ratio, not stored for cross-candidate statistics.

section_9_statistics_audit.verdict: ALL_FROZEN_STATISTICS_UNCOMPUTED. The statistics file contains only placeholders. No multiplicity correction, no bootstrap, no PBO was ever performed.

reasons: CRITICAL: Date filter missing from aggregated mask. 2010-2013 data IS in evaluated P&L. The protocol mandates 2014-2017 only for evaluation.

HIGH: All frozen statistics (WRC/SPA/RW/Holm/BH/PSR/DSR/PBO) were never computed.

MEDIUM: S4 missing 8 candidates, S5 has 24 extra vs protocol.
section_10_adjudication.explanation: The negative verdict (0 survivors) is NOT reliable because: (1) the evaluation period includes 2010-2013 data not authorized by the protocol, (2) the code is unreproducible, (3) the candidate universe deviated from the sealed protocol. The true 2014-2017-only result is unknown and could differ.
